- I'll own coordinating security and legal at FinStash. Looping Maria (legal) and procurement on this thread.

Subject: Re: FinStash MAP kickoff — security gates & retention options

Jonathan — great, thanks for the quick reply and for clarifying the 90-day default. A few clarifications from Security so we can scope the MAP tasks accurately:

1) SIG/CAIQ: we can take the existing matrix and do a technical pass focused on: data flows (ingress/egress), embedding handling, KV/prefix cache persistence, and key management. Please share the latest CAIQ export — we’ll annotate gaps and propose mitigations.

2) SOC 2: redacted copy works; we only need attestations and control descriptions plus the auditor letter.

3) DPA/Retention: to be explicit, options we typically recommend for pilots are:
   - 30 days (aggressive, minimal traces retained)
   - 90 days (balanced — preserves troubleshooting context)
   - 365 days (longer-term auditability)

   For FinStash pilot, 90 days is fine. We will add an automated purge schedule and a retention SLA to the MAP. If you have regulatory constraints (e.g., state-level recordkeeping), call them out now.

4) Evidence/attachments: please send SOC2 redacted + CAIQ export to security@redwoodinference.com. We will produce a gap tracker and a list of required artifacts (config screenshots, control owners, retention policy text).

Timeline commitment: we can complete the SIG review and provide a DPA redline within 10 business days after receiving the CAIQ + SOC2 artifacts. If procurement needs a DocuSign-ready DPA, Kim can prep the template immediately following our redline pass.

Soojin Lee
Head of Security Integrations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

- Procurement to confirm whether the DPA needs DocuSign or a countersigned PDF for pilot purchasing. (procurement@finstash.com on copy)

3) Ben/AE: schedule pilot kickoff once gap tracker/DPA redline are in — aiming for week of Aug 21 if all on track
